prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: radical full-fidelity D2K desktop UI screenshot 1536x1024.
Primary request: "Обсерватория" — a beautifully engraved celestial atlas repurposed as an interactive family catalog and automatic bypass workspace. This is an actual product screen, not a marketing page. Dark navy ink, chalk-white points, very fine cartographic lines, warm amber selected search ring, elegant italic constellation-family names. Constellations represent saved domain families, not geography, astronomy, network routes or measured physical positions.
Input references: both provided images are the mandatory visual-quality references. Borrow the deep ink grounds, delicate amber rules, antique-modern celestial engraving, italic serif display and disciplined star-chart composition. Do not copy their astronomy metrics, real constellations, photographic nebulae, hero CTA or card grid.
Layout: edge-to-edge dark navy #071421. Tiny new star-compass D2K mark in upper-left, wordmark "D2K / Обсерватория". Top-right simple plain nav "Атлас · Подборы · Журнал" and "Демонстрационные данные". Below top header left text "Движок работает" with small solid amber point. Main canvas occupies ~80% of screen and feels like one enormous carefully typeset atlas plate framed by single hairline; no sidebar or panels within panels.
Dominant chart: enormous circular engraved atlas field, centered slightly left, with faint curved graticule rings but NO numeric coordinate scales or geographical labels. Three distinct clusters of sparse chalk-white selectable points joined by delicately dotted lines, each a saved family constellation: italic label "googlevideo.com", readable sublabel "QUIC · IPv4 / Сохранено"; italic "cdninstagram.com", sublabel "TLS 1.3 · IPv4 / Сохранено"; italic "youtube.com", sublabel "TLS 1.2 · IPv6 / Сохранено". Three to five points per family are abstract member markers, not invented domain names or topology. One large selected saved point with subtle cream circle and leader to its label. Overall graceful asymmetrical chart, silence around clusters, no thousands of glitter particles, no photoreal stars, no fluorescent glow.
Active searches at outer perimeter, not mixed into saved families: amber ring around one perimeter point labelled "meduza.io", "TLS 1.3 · IPv4", "Проверяем обход". Another quiet outlined point labelled "rutracker.org", "TLS 1.2 · IPv4", "Изучаем соединение". Small perimeter title "Подборы". These are visual anchors for selecting actual tasks.
Selected detail is set directly into negative space at right, no card container: elegant 45px italic "meduza.io", small uppercase "ТЕКУЩИЙ ПОДБОР"; plain readable labels "Протокол / TLS 1.3", "Адресация / IPv4", "Этап / Проверяем обход", "Вариантов проверено / 2". Then simple underlined "Подробности →". Fine legend below chart: "● Семейство   ◯ Подбор   ◎ Выбрано" and explicit text "Схема семейств, не карта сети". Small search control "Найти домен…" is embedded in chart bottom margin.
Stationary bottom full-width control rail, separated by amber hairline: left "D2K / Работает" with large clearly outlined buttons "Остановить" and "Перезапустить"; right "Telegram / Подключён" and "Выключить". Plain footnote "Telegram работает независимо. Доступность сайтов не проверяется."
Typography: excellent Cyrillic, graceful italic serif for family labels and selected domain, small precise sans-serif/monospaced metadata, ample whitespace, contrast high. Restrained warm cream text on navy. Very subtle engraved markings, astronomy grammar but functional not fantasy. No old logo or robot; one new tiny compass-star mark only.
Constraints: chart must be overwhelmingly dominant, not a normal dashboard. No KPI, timeline plot, speed/throughput/load/latency, astronomy coordinates, invented metrics, infinite particle animations, glow gradients, cards or sidebar. No marketing oversized slogan. Domain contexts must stay accurate. Render one elegant stable moment with clear controls and truthful demo label.
